about:
I am a product-first builder and design-minded engineer focused on campus infrastructure and founder networks.

Currently building clstr.in, a verified campus social OS for college students with institutional trust and local network effects.

I ship fast without breaking trust, learn through real user feedback, and document the journey in public.

Open to connecting with student founders, builders, and campus operators.
